summary.text: Paul Donato is a Democratic state representative from Medford who has represented the 35th Middlesex District since 2001 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Before joining the House he served as mayor of Medford from 1980 to 1985.

paragraphs.text: Donato attended Medford High School and the University of Massachusetts at Boston, according to his legislative biography.
He served on the Medford School Committee from 1972 to 1975 and on the Medford City Council from 1976 to 1985 and again from 1996 to 2001, serving as council president in 1999-2000.
He was Medford's deputy mayor in 1978-1979 and its mayor from 1980 to 1985.
Ballotpedia says he also chaired the Medford Democratic City Committee.
Donato has served in the Massachusetts House since 2001 and lists his profession as legislator and manufacturers' representative.
He serves on the House Committee on Rules and the Joint Committees on Revenue and on Rules.
His biography lists him as the author of the state's bullying bill and as a member of the Special Commission on Grandparents Raising Grandchildren and the Special Commission on Municipal Relief.
